title: What a body presents to a field object: the source at first order in the coupling

key_results.statement: For every product start, to first order in $\gamma$ at fixed $\lambda$: $i\,\mathrm dV_f/\mathrm d\lambda=[G_f,V_f]+R_f$, $G_f=C_f+\sum_xs_x(\lambda)\Phi_x$; the source field of the listing of the question is $s_x=\gamma\langle\xi(\lambda)\vert Q_x\vert\xi(\lambda)\rangle$ with $\xi(\lambda)=e^{-iH_R\lambda}(\Psi_b\otimes\chi)$; for a pair $s_x=\gamma_1\langle Q^{(1)}_x\rangle+\gamma_2\langle Q^{(2)}_x\rangle$.

$\lVert R_f(\lambda)\rVert_1\le8\lVert C_{bf}\rVert^2\lvert\lambda\rvert$ with $\lVert C_{bf}\rVert\le\lvert\gamma\rvert(\mu_{N-1}+\tau)\max_x\lVert\Phi_x\rVert$ on every ring and open chain; the view differs from its $G_f$-evolution by at most $4\lVert C_{bf}\rVert^2\lambda^2$.

Branch start on a ring ($\sigma=\pm1$, level $k$, label $p$; $\kappa=0$ or $X\chi=0$), in the listing of the question: $S^{(a)}_{k,\sigma}=\gamma\sigma M_k^2/\omega_k(p)$, $S^{(c)}_{k,\sigma}=\gamma\sigma\omega_k(p)$, $\omega_k=\sqrt{M_k^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$; constant in $\lambda$; packets give the $\lvert g(p)\rvert^2$-weighted sum over $p\in\frac{2\pi}n\mathbb Z$; records give a correction of first order in $\kappa$ at fixed $\lambda$.

$S^{(c)}=\gamma L_b$, $S^{(a)}=\gamma M_k^2/L_b$ with $L_b=\langle C_{\rm D}\rangle=\sigma\omega_k(p)$; holds in the listing of the question and is not invariant (moves of $Z^{\rm D}_b$ change $L_b$, moves of $\mathbb 1_b\otimes W$ into $C_{bf}$ change $S$).

Pair in an eigenvector of $C_{\rm pair}$ on fixed levels: $S^{(a)}_{12}=\sum_i\gamma_iM^{(i)}_{k_i}\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle$, $S^{(c)}_{12}=\sum_i\gamma_i\langle C_{{\rm D},i}\rangle$, equal to $\gamma(E_{12}-\langle U\rangle)$ for $\gamma_1=\gamma_2=\gamma$; the binding term contributes no term of its own.

Control: for $U=u\sigma^{(1)}_1\sigma^{(2)}_1$ at $p_1=p_2=0$ the pair presents $(\gamma_1M^{(1)}_{k_1}+\gamma_2M^{(2)}_{k_2})M/\sqrt{M^2+u^2}$, different from the sum of the free sources when $u\neq0$ and $\gamma_1M^{(1)}_{k_1}+\gamma_2M^{(2)}_{k_2}\neq0$; on the ring the difference reaches $f$ as $\frac1n(S_{12}-\sum_i\gamma_iM^{(i)}_{k_i})\sum_x\mathring\Phi_x$, fixed by $C$ and the two starts.

The replacements leaving $C$ unchanged are exactly moves of single-object operators (constants, place-dependent, internal) between the terms containing the object; $C_{\{b,f\}}=\gamma\sum_xQ_x\otimes\mathring\Phi_x$ is fixed by $C$.

The component listing $(H^\circ_R,C_{\{f\}},K)$ is fixed by $C$; its first-order generator $G^\circ_f=\mathring C_f+\sum_xs^\circ_x\mathring\Phi_x$, $s^\circ_x=\gamma\langle\xi^\circ\vert Q_x\vert\xi^\circ\rangle$, is a function of $C$ and the start, invariant under every replacement (2.11); the generator (2.3) equals it modulo $\mathbb 1_f$ up to $4\lVert C_{bf}\rVert^2\lvert\lambda\rvert$; its change between two starts is fixed by $C$ and the two starts.

For $\gamma\neq0$ and some $\mathring\Phi_y\neq0$: a constant added to $\sigma_3\otimes(m\mathbb 1_N+D)$ is a convention iff all $\mathring\Phi_x$ are equal; otherwise the zero of the body operator is fixed by $C$.

Source field, total and ratios between bodies read from a listing are not fixed by $C$ and the start (shift by any start-independent $W$ per body); in the component split, realized by the listing of the question, they are fixed up to $1/a$ (ratios exactly) if the $\mathring\Phi_x$ are linearly independent, $S^\circ$ and $S^\circ_1/S^\circ_2$ if all $\mathring\Phi_x=\mathring\Phi\neq0$; under the same conditions the additive changes between two starts ($\Delta s^{(i)}_x$, $\Delta S_i$) and the ratio $\Delta S_1/\Delta S_2$ (where $\Delta S_2\neq0$) are the same in every split, but the change of a ratio, $\Delta(S_1/S_2)$, is in general not (control at $p=0$).

open_issues: M_k is taken as μ_k = m + d_k, the half-gap of the on-site block; the question does not quote its definition.
Items 2 and 3 are derived on rings of n sites; open chains and their boundary corrections are not treated.
With records (κ > 0, Xχ ≠ 0) only a bound on the change of the total source is given; the O(κ) correction is not computed.

Source field, total and ratios are values of a split (the listing of the question realizes the component split); whether a later package singles out a split, and which field descriptions fix the common factor 1/a, are left to the packages on the field's response and profile.
For the pair only eigenvectors of the pair contract and one control are treated; no general relation between the pair's source and those of its free parts.
